original_test_intent: Verify the raw Internal Connector Type enum in every SMBIOS Type 8 record matches the approved board-side connector or defined None/Other/Unknown state for that port and remains associated with the same designators, external type and port type after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 8 structures, retain the internal connector enum byte with handle and both designators/types plus port type, decode using the applicable SMBIOS table, compare with the approved board map, reboot and repeat without physical manipulation.
manual_activity: A user approves the Type 8 internal connector enum map, handling of None/Other/Unknown and reboot plan. Metadata validation is automatable; optional visual confirmation is separate.
required_inputs: Expected internal connector enum per Type 8 record
Applicable SMBIOS connector-type enumeration and reserved/vendor value policy
Approved meaning of None, Other and Unknown for internal-side absence or nonstandard connectors
Board revision and full internal/external designator/type plus port-type map
Validated raw/decoded parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not plug/unplug, probe or alter connectors, cables, boards or firmware.
Preserve raw enum byte and full Type 8 record identity; label-only output cannot prove which port owns the value.
Do not reject `None` automatically: it can be meaningful for a connector record whose physical endpoint exists only on the other side, subject to board policy.
Do not infer mechanical geometry or physical population solely from firmware enum text.
Stop on undefined/reserved enum, connector-pair/map contradiction, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect/decode internal connector enums with complete Type 8 context, compare with the board port map and persistence before/after reboot.
Do not manipulate connectors, replace metadata with visual assumptions or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the board-side connector enum map and None/Other/Unknown/vendor handling.
Arrange separate visual inspection only if desired; approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The field label is correct, but grep loses the raw enum and handle/designator/external/port context needed to disambiguate repeated records.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 8 records and compare the internal connector enum byte together with both designators/types and port type against the board map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Internal Connector Type scope, Type 8 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: CONTEXTUAL TYPE8 INTERNAL CONNECTOR ENUM VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw internal connector enum with the applicable SMBIOS table, bind it to full record identity and validate the connector-pair/port map before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, board revision and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 8 connector-type and port-type enumerations, approved board/connector map and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw enum, None semantics and full connector-pair identity without expanding into physical inspection.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; detects right-looking values attached to wrong port records and handles valid internal absence explicitly.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-record enum/board map and special-value policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: SMBIOS enum granularity may not capture exact mechanical revision or physical population; those require separate evidence if in scope.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve None, Other or a defined connector enum per record/board revision, but must preserve the paired Type 8 context and cannot infer physical correctness from metadata alone.
expected_evidence: Approved board revision, per-record internal connector map, enum/special-value policy and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 8 table with handle, raw internal enum, decoded value, both designators/types and port type
Record-level mapping and connector-pair consistency result
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict; any physical observation clearly separated
